reserves.name: USDS backing through Gnosis bridge infrastructure
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Sky Ecosystem USDS held through Gnosis bridge infrastructure

reserveReview.rationale: Gnosis documents that the USDS migration on the xDAI bridge is complete and identifies xDAI as the stable token used for payments and fees on Gnosis Chain. The established bridge-backed reserve relationship is USDS.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Gnosis Chain issuer documentation for the completed USDS xDAI bridge migration
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No direct reserve asset remains unidentified in the documented USDS bridge model.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed documentation confirms the USDS bridge migration but does not establish contract-level custody segregation, legal insolvency treatment, or rehypothecation terms.
